# SC06 evidence contract

The frozen experiment is `docs/gates/SC06/plan.md` at c574bcdf65168c48ecdc5f0b94f4377959f61b13. Cases are builder-authored synthetic finite contacts/candidates, not naturalistic incidents or unseen held-out inputs. Every native audit receipt retains its full source frame and clauses; DRead recomputes its audit before using it. Source identifiers are frame-bound in this laboratory, not globally independent real-world observations.

Actual inputs are observations/capabilities, scope, raw clauses, receipts, declared development surface and scoped resource grant. Test case names and expected outcomes do not enter opportunity cognition. Module schema cases exercise the inherited inert rule vocabulary; explicit semantic-drift keys are module data, not source evidence of a defect.

The independent checker recomputes finite clause meanings and omissions, verifies source roots and distinct material families, and compares canonical/severed/restored results. It is offline JavaScript, not Java or a Miter runtime dependency. Native MeTTa determines intention, audit, opportunity, DevelopRNA, generation purpose, vocabulary admission, quarantine and inert interpretation. Prolog handles exact JSON/field projection, hashes, storage, HTTP, polling, cancellation and state readback.

Final suite: 16 opportunity cases; 13 module-schema cases; five native arms; 10 native compiler cases across roles, names, completion, released obligations and unavailable operations; five trial-data callability checks. Boundary suite: eleven replay/attack/real-fake-HTTP cases and three parser-state classes. Replays and altered provider envelopes are explicitly laboratory tests, not new model authorship or fresh evidence.

Two actual local model calls are within the original allocation. `live-001` is retained as partial execution, not a clean pass. `live-002` completes the native return and preserves the loaded 129-atom compass plus three nonempty fixture canaries while adding exactly one trial atom. Protected canaries are test data, not production Soul/history/registry contents. No production data is touched.

Schema validity, trial loading and inert plan callability do not prove candidate benefit. The compiler is tested independently; it is not a G22 baseline-versus-candidate experiment. No promotion, external human emission, active registry update, NACE or server-confirmed cancellation is claimed. See the attempt history and rejoin assessment for the remaining recurring-driver integration gap.
